title: Trying to Sleep (Vocadito 33)

provenance.detail: Solo vocal from Rachel M. Bittner, Katherine Pasalo, Juan José Bosch, Gabriel Meseguer-Brocal and David Rubinstein, vocadito-33, CC BY 4.0. The public dry MP3 is a listening copy of the exact WAV used for every candidate. Candidate mixes sum that dry vocal and the generated backing at fixed gain.
